payload.feature: Verify two delivered slices. Slice I (merge 66d809d): parallel panels - SeatBody Single|Panel, closed aggregate vocabulary (unanimous-pass, review-panel worst-member-wins), barrier join in declared order with member checkpoint evidence, indeterminate member parks / failed member retryable, plus tracked-debt payoff (REVIEW-RESIDUAL-FIXED deny in bundles/verify, cross-bundle driver parity test). Slice J (merge a0cb8c5): forge ui embedded read-only surface (loopback, std-only, include_str page, SSE) and causal threading - causation_id on every engine append. Slice-specific checks: cargo test -p forge-cli (expect 26 machine-proof + ui tests), .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_drivers.py (5 incl. parity), and confirm both merges are on main. Review the combined diff (git show 66d809d a0cb8c5). Note for review: the UI must submit no commands and write nothing - check the page and routes for any mutation path.

result.notes: Both slices verified green. (1) cargo test --workspace: 14 suites, 47 passed, 0 failed. (2) .venv/bin/pytest -q: 42 passed. (3) generate_evaluator_corpus.py wrote 97 cases; git status --porcelain fixtures/ empty — no drift. (4) forge compile bundles/self (digest fc812a7a…) and bundles/verify (digest 85bbe5ae…) both compile under the constitutional lint. Slice-specific: cargo test -p forge-cli = 26 machine-proof tests (incl. six panel cases: unanimous-pass with member evidence, worst-member-wins + input merge, one-failing-member fails phase, security-hold member hard-stops, member-vanish parks indeterminate, compile_rejects_bad_panels) + ui::tests::page_runs_and_run_detail_serve_read_only, all passing. pytest tests/test_drivers.py = 5 passed incl. test_driver_files_identical_across_bundles (cross-bundle parity). REVIEW-RESIDUAL-FIXED hard deny present in bundles/verify/policy.json (residual + fixes_applied -> stop). causation_id: engine threads current_cause through every append, operator/accepted chains to its commanded event, machine proof asserts causation_id on every event seq>1 (passed inside full_delivery_completes_exports_and_replays). Both merges on main: git branch --contains lists main for 66d809d and a0cb8c5; a0cb8c5 is HEAD. UI mutation review: ui.rs routes are / (include_str page), [path-1], [path-2]<id>, [path-3]<id> only; handler dispatches on path, calls only Store::open/list_runs/load/head_hash + fold — no append, no create_run, no command submission anywhere; the page JS uses only GET fetches and EventSource, no forms or POSTs. Observations (non-blocking): Store::open (shared reader used by all surfaces) creates the db file/schema if the path is missing — a filesystem side effect, not a journal/command write; the handler ignores HTTP method, so a POST to a read route behaves as the GET (still read-only); ui.html injects event payload JSON into innerHTML unescaped — journal-sourced XSS on a loopback read-only page, worth a future escape pass; bundle manifests hash drivers/__pycache__/*.pyc alongside sources.

Adversarial review of merges 66d809d (parallel panels) and a0cb8c5 (forge ui + causal threading), both confirmed ancestors of main. Slice checks green: machine_proof 26/26, ui unit test 1/1, init_doctor 2/2, pytest tests/test_drivers.py 5/5 incl. cross-bundle driver parity; REVIEW-RESIDUAL-FIXED deny present in bundles/verify/policy.json (and REVIEW-CLEAN-FIXED covers the clean verdict). UI mutation-path check: routes are / , [path-1], [path-2]<id>, [path-3]<id> — all reads; page JS uses only GET fetch + EventSource, no command submission. FINDINGS (all in the delivered slices, none fixed — reviewer is read-only): [1] MEDIUM security — stored XSS in crates/forge-cli/src/ui.html: loadDetail/loadRuns build DOM via innerHTML template literals from journal-derived strings with no HTML escaping — event payload JSON (includes seat-authored `notes` merged by aggregate_results), park_reason (includes driver error text and raw invalid seat results from schema-evidence parks), run ids, labels. Seat/driver-controlled text therefore executes as JS in the operator's browser when a run is viewed. Mitigations: loopback-only bind, no mutating route on the origin, and seats already hold local execution during runs — but a journal db authored or tampered outside this machine executes attacker JS on open. [2] LOW security — crates/forge-cli/src/ui.rs ignores all request headers (no Host validation): DNS rebinding lets a remote web page read [path-1] and full journals from 127.0.0.1:8383 while `forge ui` runs; HTTP method is also ignored (harmless today, all routes read-only). [3] LOW robustness — SSE handler leaks one thread + socket per disconnected client on quiet runs (disconnect detected only on next head change; 1s poll loop forever; thread-per-connection unbounded). [4] INFO fit — 'writes nothing' is not quite literal: handle() -> Store::open create_dir_all's the parent and creates+initializes an empty db when the --db path does not exist; no events are ever appended, so no journal tamper path. [5] INFO correctness — causal-threading fidelity: single-seat checkpoint appends bypass Engine::append so current_cause never advances through them (checkpoints and the closing effect event share one parent rather than chaining), and operator/commanded carries no causation_id, so the 'every event past run/started names its cause' proof holds only on operator-free paths like the one tested. [6] INFO fit — aggregate_results doc says out-of-vocabulary member results rank worst and park via decide(); true for review-panel, but unanimous-pass coerces any non-'pass' string to 'fail' (evidence kept in notes.verdicts) — coercion in the safe direction, in tension with law 0001. [7] INFO — review-panel member reporting residual with omitted severity aggregates to severity 'none'; acknowledged in REVIEW-RESIDUAL-OK's reason, evidence preserved. Verdict: residual with security residuals present (findings 1–2); has_security_residual is true and by this bundle's constitution that is the operator's risk call, not mine.
